svg.title: SCR04.S0 Group summary and local mapping draft

g.text: SCR04.S0 · Group summary and local mapping draft
Service Running (desired running) · MCP ready · ADB offline · view ready · catalog ready · ARC disabled
Stable group ID/revision/hash, dependencies and permission/applicability facets
Small atomic member IDs, paired register/unregister, required types and provenance
Exact client ID/session epoch; local UI does not impersonate MCP client
Enabled subject to exact local/backend authority gates
Job/query and relevance explanation; unassigned inventory search link
Rank bounded group summaries from deterministic index; optional semantic ranking is advisory
Effect: Search returns bounded summaries; owner preview is not client activation.
Recovery: Describe one group or edit atomic member/dependency draft.
Modal drawer below840dp; persistent rail at840dp+. Back returns previous detail, with Discard/Stay for dirty
Design only · local control/state contract; no Android implementation or authority granted
